scripts.vpub-check-vars: if [ -z "$VERSION_TYPE" ] || [ -z "$PACKAGE" ] || [ -z "$NPM_TAG" ]; then echo 'Error: VERSION_TYPE, PACKAGE, or NPM_TAG is not set'; exit 1; fi; if ! git diff --quiet HEAD; then echo 'Error: the git tree is not clean — commit or stash first (the release flow makes its own commit)'; exit 1; fi
scripts.vpub:commit-and-publish: NAME=$(node -p "require('./packages/$PACKAGE/package.json').name") && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./packages/$PACKAGE/package.json').version") && npm run --prefix ./packages/$PACKAGE npm-publish && git add ./packages/$PACKAGE/package.json package-lock.json && git commit -m "chore(release): $NAME@$VERSION" && ([ "$NPM_TAG" = "latest" ] && git tag "${NAME#@uicast/}-v$VERSION" || true) && git push && git push --tags
scripts.vpub: npm run vpub-check-vars && npm t && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run vpub:version && npm run vpub:commit-and-publish
scripts.vpub-notest: npm run vpub-check-vars && npm run vpub:version && npm run vpub:commit-and-publish
scripts.patch: PACKAGE=${PACKAGE:-core} NPM_TAG=latest VERSION_TYPE=patch npm run vpub
scripts.minor: PACKAGE=${PACKAGE:-core} NPM_TAG=latest VERSION_TYPE=minor npm run vpub
scripts.BREAKING-major: PACKAGE=${PACKAGE:-core} NPM_TAG=latest VERSION_TYPE=major npm run vpub
scripts.beta: PACKAGE=${PACKAGE:-core} NPM_TAG=beta VERSION_TYPE="prerelease --preid=beta" npm run vpub
scripts.draft: PACKAGE=${PACKAGE:-core} NPM_TAG=draft VERSION_TYPE="prerelease --preid=draft" npm run vpub
scripts.patch-notest-IAMSURE: PACKAGE=${PACKAGE:-core} NPM_TAG=latest VERSION_TYPE=patch npm run vpub-notest
scripts.minor-notest-IAMSURE: PACKAGE=${PACKAGE:-core} NPM_TAG=latest VERSION_TYPE=minor npm run vpub-notest
scripts.beta-notest-IAMSURE: PACKAGE=${PACKAGE:-core} NPM_TAG=beta VERSION_TYPE="prerelease --preid=beta" npm run vpub-notest
scripts.draft-notest: PACKAGE=${PACKAGE:-core} NPM_TAG=draft VERSION_TYPE="prerelease --preid=draft" npm run vpub-notest
